```python
from datetime import datetime

def choose_books(rows, asof):
    latest = {}
    for row in rows:
        book = row['book']
        if book not in latest or row['observed_at'] > latest[book]['observed_at']:
            latest[book] = row
    out = {}
    for book, row in latest.items():
        observed = datetime.fromisoformat(row['observed_at'])
        expires = datetime.fromisoformat(row['expires_at'])
        if observed <= asof <= expires:
            probability = 100 / (abs(float(row['odds'])) + 100)
            out[book] = {'row': row, 'probability': probability}
    return out
```
